messages:
alana: Quick kickoff  want to run a contributor-focused refapp launch: tutorial, lightweight benchmark, and a contributor hour to drive OSS PRs
ben: Love this. Flow: publish tutorial + reproducible notebook, follow with a 60m contributor session focused on landing small issues and bench reproductions
cory: Timeline idea: tutorial blog 10/12, notebook 10/13, contributor hour 10/20. Gives a week for folks to try the notebook and open issues
dina: I'll own landing page + social copy (two threads: Twitter + LinkedIn) and a short partner note for ecosystem folks
alana: Bench angle: small, clear numbers for reproducibility (env + warmup) and a "how to run in CI" snippet
ben: Notebook should include a GH Action example to run the bench on push and save CSV artifact
cory: snippet for GH Action:
```yaml
name: run-bench
on: [workflow_dispatch, push]
jobs:
  bench:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python notebooks/run_bench.py --save results.csv
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: bench-results
          path: results.csv
```
dina: inbound routing: capture signups -> HubSpot tag `contributors-drive-10-20` and set nurture: announce + reminder + post with PR checklist
compose-bot: created calendar event "Refapp Contributor Hour" on 2026-10-20 17:00 UTC with recording enabled and invites sent to alana, ben, cory, dina
alana: contributor hour format: 10m intro, 30m hands-on issues (labelled "good first PR"), 20m open debugging/help. Registrants get notebook link + a curated issue list
ben: gating: notebook download requires email; repo public. add a prefilled issue template: `bench-results` and `how-to-reproduce`
cory: PR rules: open to `community-launch` repo with branch prefix `contributors/` and add checkboxes: reproduce, docs, test-run
dina: marketing assets due dates:
- landing + social copy: due Mon
- curated issue list + PR templates: due Wed
- notebook + GH Action: due Thu
- partner 1-pager: due next Tue
alana: let's run an internal dry-run 10/17 17:00 UTC to walk the flow and verify GH Action artifacts show up in CI
ben: will scope a tiny automation to parse results.csv and generate the small comparison table for the blog (`model | quant | tok/sec | notes`)
dina: messaging: emphasize "contributor-friendly" and "benchmarks-as-code" in all assets. short tagline for landing: "Try, reproduce, and contribute: refapp reproducible benches"
cory: tiny ops note  allow enterprise contributors to request private test data via form on the landing page (mark with `enterprise-request`)
alana: assigning tasks in Asana and adding PR reviewers. thanks team! :sparkles:
